query:
SELECT MAX(display_name) AS "display_name?",
               COALESCE(SUM(duration_seconds), 0)::BIGINT AS "seconds!",
               COALESCE(SUM(points), 0)::BIGINT AS "points!",
               COUNT(*) AS "sessions!"
        FROM activity.voice_session_log
        WHERE started_at >= $1
          AND user_id = $2
        GROUP BY user_id
